import math

def layer_norm(x, eps=1e-5):
    """Normalize one vector to ~mean 0 / ~std 1.
    Return (x - mean) / sqrt(variance + eps) for each component."""
    n = len(x)
    mean = sum(x) / n
    var = sum((v - mean) ** 2 for v in x) / n
    std = math.sqrt(var + eps)
    return [(v - mean) / std for v in x]

vec = [2.0, 4.0, 6.0, 8.0]
out = layer_norm(vec)
print([round(v, 4) for v in out])
